title: Refer after 7 days without improvement
items: Atopic dermatitis (the first lecture where she gave it)
Topical antibiotics: contact the prescriber if no improvement after 7 days
src: "What other lecture did we talk about 7 days referral? Quite a few of them" (11/12 lecture); Patel Outdoor slides 13, 16, 31

title: No topical hydrocortisone under 2 years old
items: Applies to its uses on her topical OTC chart: insect bites and stings, plant dermatitis, atopic dermatitis, very mild psoriasis
Under 2 years, a skin protectant such as petrolatum or calamine can be used for insect bites

title: Tube size from fingertip units
rows: Fingertip units × {{0.5 g}} × applications a day × days, then round up to the tube size
Both feet = 4 units × 0.5 g × 2 a day × 3 days = {{12 g}} → {{15 g}} tube
src: "It's come back 3 times now, so make sure you practice calculations" (11/12 lecture); Patel Outdoor slide 5
